# AiFeedback

```ts
import { AiFeedback } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The row under an AI response for rating it and acting on it: like, dislike, copy, regenerate. Use it under assistant replies (usually through AiMessageResponse's feedback prop). To show a recorded thumbs result read-only, use Thumbs Rating.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `'liked' \| 'disliked' \| null` | — | Controlled rating. Pair with onValueChange. |
| `defaultValue` | `'liked' \| 'disliked' \| null` | `null` | Uncontrolled initial rating. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: AiFeedbackValue) => void` | — | Called with 'liked', 'disliked', or null when the choice is cleared. |
| `onCopy` | `() => void` | — | Shows Copy and calls this when it's pressed; announces "Copied". |
| `onRegenerate` | `() => void` | — | Called on Regenerate. |
| `showRegenerate` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the Regenerate button (Figma showRegenerate) — only rendered when onRegenerate is set. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Response feedback'` | Accessible name for the group. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onCopy'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<AiFeedback onValueChange={rate} onCopy={copy} onRegenerate={retry} />
<AiFeedback value={rating} onValueChange={setRating} />
<AiFeedback defaultValue="liked" showRegenerate={false} />
```

## Design tokens used

`--radius-1000`, `--space-025`, `--color-secondary-secondary`, `--color-secondary-secondary-overlay`, `--color-tonal-tonal-secondary-overlay`, `--color-text-icon-on-tonal-secondary`, `--stroke-300`, `--color-primary-primary`

## Accessibility

- A role="group" named "Response feedback".
- Like/dislike are a single-choice pair ("Good response", "Bad response"): Radix exposes them as radios that report aria-checked; arrow keys move between them.
- Copy announces "Copied" through a polite live region.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Put feedback under answers that can be wrong | Ask for feedback on system notices |
| Follow a dislike with a short optional form | Force a reason before recording a dislike |
| Keep the order: like, dislike, copy, regenerate | Reorder or add unrelated actions |
